basic_info.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Production RAG & AI agents for high-stakes documents and money | 88% faster document review, $1.1B in transactions processed | Python, Java, AWS Bedrock, Gemini
basic_info.about:
Building production-grade AI systems that solve real problems. I am the Founder of Mass Ave Labs, where we provide intelligent automations for small businesses. I was recently named a Top 3 Finalist at HackwithDC 2026. For this project, I built a full-stack AI agent featuring a production memory persistence layer that handles conversation turns. By architecting a custom SQLite schema, I enabled deterministic follow-ups and context awareness.

During my time at Amivero, I architected an end-to-end Serverless RAG platform using AWS Bedrock, Titan embeddings, and Claude Sonnet. This system achieved an 88% reduction in document review cycles and contributed to an unsolicited $8M federal contract award.  I also designed and delivered an OCR ingestion pipeline for birth certificates with state-aware validation logic. This project was completed one month ahead of schedule and was demoed to over 3,000 professionals for federal healthcare programs.  

My technical expertise includes Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic workflows, and LLM integration across Claude, Llama, and Gemini. I specialize in system design for scale, including Docker, Kubernetes, and Cloudflare deployment, as well as AI security and prompt injection prevention.  

I also share technical insights on AI architecture and production deployment through my writing at Elisheba Builds.  

If you are building AI products, optimizing LLM systems, or thinking about agent architecture, let’s talk. I am always open to discussing AI engineering, system design, and potential partnerships for Mass Ave Labs.

experience.title: Founder & Principal Software Engineer
experience.description:
• Built two end-to-end product demos, an AI chatbot and a lead generation automation workflow , using third-party chatbot integration, Make, and Airtable to showcase core product capabilities to prospective clients

• Developed a pilot proposal for a local gym client outlining a lead generation strategy, defined requirements, and delivered actionable recommendations to improve their existing processes

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
• Engineered a serverless RAG pipeline (API Gateway, Lambda, Bedrock, OpenSearch) full-stack production system in 3 weeks, which is projected to cut document review by 88% and onboarding time by 70%.

• Mentored software engineering interns by leading daily standups, pair coding, and design walkthroughs; explained complex topics (e.g. rebasing, vector DBs, LLMs), guided career planning, and reduced ramp-up time by ~30% through hands-on technical and professional coaching

• Led development of an OCR-based birth certificate ingestion service—owning architecture, building validation for seals/watermarks/formatting, and unblocking stalled requirements through cross-team alignment, and enhancing front-end code in React—resulting in a successful demo to 3,000 industry professionals a month ahead of schedule.

• Designed and began implementing a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application to automate document ingestion from Microsoft SharePoint, enabling secure file retrieval and context-aware query generation for federal contracting workflows.

experience.title: Independent AI Engineer
experience.description:
• Achieved 40% improvement in development efficiency by refining coding workflows, debugging strategies, and system optimization techniques.
• Applied an AI inference system (Ollama) to streamline debugging, optimize code, and accelerate feature development.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
• Owned optimization of investment workflows for subscriptions, generating $1.3M in new revenue through concurrent processing of subscription rollouts.

• Led the design and development of a distributed cloud microservices architecture and name-matching algorithm that raised identification coverage of bank accounts by 90%.

• Decreased fraud detection false positives by 45% and reduced the workload of an internal team by 90% through Java code implementation. This improvement enhanced overall system efficiency, accuracy, and reliability.

• Mentored junior engineers, contributing to a 15% improvement in bug resolution.

• Led a project that streamlined OFAC verification and evaluation for ~50k accounts, strengthening compliance with international sanctions regulations and mitigating company risk.

• Implemented envelope encryption in AWS DynamoDB introducing a second layer of security and enhancing stored data protection by 100%. Shared knowledge cross-team to ensure understanding.

• Contributed to cost analysis and projected savings of 50% of AWS costs by removing ECS resource duplication.

experience.title: Software Engineer II
experience.description:
• Minimized transaction failures in IRA offering expansion by adding bank account verification for $90M in IRA holdings.

• Increased lead to invest rate and grew new investors to the company through promotions project that helped to reach the company's goal of democratizing real estate.

• Updated automated processes for a new NAV settlement model, enabling internal teams to efficiently manage more types of funds and facilitating company growth.

• Added ~2 million dollars to the company by implementing critical dispute logic handling for debit and credit card project.

experience.title: Software Engineer III
experience.description:
• Developed Spring API endpoints & Kafka streams for data processing in $73.4M contract to modernize USCIS Risk & Fraud Systems.

• Implemented troubleshooting techniques using Eclipse IDE, server logs, and browser dev tools to successfully resolve bugs.

• Created new JUnit tests to increase code coverage to 90%, improving application integrity.

• Assisted team members with their workload to ensure sprint completion on time.

experience.title: Software Engineer  II
experience.description:
• Developed and debugged web applications using Ruby on Rails and React.

• Lead in ensuring new developers are set up on application quickly to immediately contribute to addressing the backlog. 

• Evaluate new software products and technologies for company and team, and provide recommendations to enhance existing systems or products.

projects.name: ChaosFit — Real-Time AI Fitness Coach
projects.description:
AI coach that watches your form and delivers real-time corrections through your phone or laptop camera. Built for parents and anyone who can't control their environment. Setup takes 30 seconds, no gym required.

Submitted to the Google Gemini Live Agent Challenge (11,238 participants, $80K prize pool). Continuing development post-hackathon.

Built with: Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio Preview · Google ADK · FastAPI · Firestore · Cloud Run

Led all architecture decisions as sole engineer across a 2-week sprint.

Includes Docker containerization and Kubernetes CronJob orchestration for batch processing, demonstrating production ML deployment patterns. - https://github.com/ElishebaW/fed_reserve_int_rate_predictions
